# 1691: what's on in Limerick

> 1691 publishes a free weekly list of events in Limerick: live music, food and drink, arts and culture, family days and outdoor events. This site holds the current week's list, updated weekly, and an archive of past weeks. It is published by Sparch Media Limited.

Current week: Tue 10 – Tue 17 Nov 2026, 57 events. Times and details can change, so check with the venue.

## This week

- [What's on in Limerick this week](https://events.1691.ie/): the full list, grouped by day
- [Plain-text version](https://events.1691.ie/this-week.txt): the same events as plain text, with links

## Past weeks

- [Archive index](https://events.1691.ie/archive): 26 earlier weekly editions
